hints.title: Independent Character Counting
hints.text: Same-end substrings can be grouped by their boundary character c from 'a' to 'z'.

hints.title: Combinatorial Pairs
hints.text: If character c appears k times in range [l, r], it forms k substrings of length 1 and C(k, 2) substrings of length > 1, totaling k * (k + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Frequency Table
hints.text: Precompute 26 prefix frequency arrays over s to obtain count k of each character in O(1) per query.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: 26 prefix frequency arrays with O(26) answer computation per query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning [l, r] per query takes O(q * n) which times out.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 2D prefix sums over alphabet to answer range character combinations in O(26).
